income.title: Let's set up your budget
income.subtitle: First, tell us about your monthly income so we can create a budget that works for you.

recurring.title: Any recurring payments?
recurring.subtitle: Add your regular fixed expenses so we can account for them in your budget.

plan.title: Your budget plan
plan.subtitle: Based on your income, we suggest this 50/30/20 split.
plan.noIncome: Add your income on the first step to see a plan.
plan.noRoom: Your recurring payments use all of your income, so there is nothing left to split.

goal.title: What are you saving for?
goal.subtitle: Set a savings goal and we'll help you track progress.

timeline.title: Pick your timeline
timeline.canAfford: You can afford {name} in {months} months saving {amount}/month.
timeline.cannotAfford: Your savings of {amount}/month don't cover these. Pick a later custom date.

complete.title: Setup complete!
complete.tip: You can change your budgets and goal at any time.
complete.partialFailure: Some items couldn't be saved. You can add them later.

dashboard.title: Your money at a glance
dashboard.body: Home shows this month's net, your budgets and recent activity.

addTransaction.title: Add a transaction in seconds
addTransaction.body: Tap + on any tab, type the amount and pick a category.

reports.title: See where your money goes
reports.body: Reports shows trends, categories and insights.

cta.title: You're all set!
cta.body: You now know the basics. Let's start tracking your finances!
